title: Introduction to Hidden Markov Models
author: Frank O Aylward
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yhqft5w

steps.title: Download and prepare dataset
steps.instruction: Clone the HMM introduction repository and prepare the NifH protein sequence file.

substeps.instruction: Run `git clone https://github.com/faylward/hmm_introduction`
Navigate into the directory: `cd hmm_introduction`
Unzip the NifH protein file: `gunzip nifh.faa.gz`
Get sequence statistics using `seqkit fx2tab -inl nifh.faa`

steps.title: Perform web-based multi-sequence alignment
steps.instruction: Create a global alignment of NifH proteins using the Clustal Omega web interface.

substeps.instruction: Go to https://www.ebi.ac.uk/Tools/msa/clustalo/
Paste the contents of the `nifh.faa` file into the window
Click 'submit' to generate the multi-sequence alignment
Click 'send to mview' and click 'submit' again on the MView website to view the alignment with base conservation statistics

steps.title: Perform command-line multi-sequence alignment
steps.instruction: Generate a global alignment of NifH proteins using the Clustal Omega command-line tool.

substeps.instruction: Run `clustalo -i nifh.faa -o nifh.aln`
Inspect the alignment file using `more nifh.aln`
Verify sequence lengths using `seqkit fx2tab -iln nifh.aln`

steps.title: Build Hidden Markov Model
steps.instruction: Create an HMM from the NifH multi-sequence alignment using HMMER.

substeps.instruction: Run `hmmbuild nifh.hmm nifh.aln`
Inspect the resulting HMM file using `more`

steps.title: Prepare test genome
steps.instruction: Download and unzip the Methanococcus vinelandii genome for testing.

substeps.instruction: Download the protein file: `wget -O methanococcus.faa.gz ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/017/165/GCF_000017165.1_ASM1716v1/GCF_000017165.1_ASM1716v1_protein.faa.gz`
Unzip the file: `gunzip methanococcus.faa.gz`

steps.title: Search HMM against protein sequences
steps.instruction: Use HMMER to search the NifH HMM against the Methanococcus vinelandii protein file.

substeps.instruction: Perform a basic search: `hmmsearch nifh.hmm methanococcus.faa > hmmout.txt`
Alternatively, perform a search with a tabulated output and E-value threshold: `hmmsearch --tblout hmm_table.txt -E 1e-10 nifh.hmm methanococcus.faa > hmmout.txt`
Browse results using `more`

steps.title: Compare results using BLASTP
steps.instruction: Perform a BLASTP search to compare the HMM results with traditional sequence alignment.

substeps.instruction: Create a BLASTP database from the NifH file: `makeblastdb -in nifh.faa -dbtype prot`
Compare Methanococcus proteins to the database: `blastp -query methanococcus.faa -db nifh.faa -evalue 1e-5 -outfmt 6 > blastpout.txt`
